description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Monangai left practice early on Sunday with an apparent knee/leg injury.
items.impact: Hope notes that Monangai suffered what appeared to be a right knee injury when Grady Jarrett tackled him from behind. Monangai slowly walked off the field with a trainer. This will be something to note as he's expected to continue to compliment D'Andre Swift in the Bears backfield.
items.title: Kyle Monangai leaves practice early Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Kittle told reporters he still has a shot to play Week 1 against the Rams.
items.impact: Kittle added he's "very confident" he won't be starting the season on the PUP list. There is expected to be a decision made on his status before the 49ers leave for Melbourne.
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) remains hopeful for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey is still not practicing on Sunday.
items.impact: McCaffrey has been absent from practice this week due to tightness. It remains unclear how serious of an injury he is dealing with. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice this week.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey remains absent from practice Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said there's no timeline for James Conner to return to 11-on-11 drills.
items.impact: Conner took a paycut this offseason and is due $2.35 million guaranteed in 2026. It is unclear what his role will be when healthy behind Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.
items.title: James Conner (ankle) without timetable to return to team drills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness did not practice on Sunday due to a shoulder injury.
items.impact: It remains unclear how serious the injury is for Van Ness.
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) misses practice Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Jeremy McNichols will be sidelined a few weeks with a quad injury.
items.impact: McNichols is competing for a depth role in the Commanders backfield.
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) to miss a few weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dolphins QB Quinn Ewers suffered a groin injury in Friday's preseason game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Ewers is currently expected to enter the season as the backup. It is unclear how serious the injury is.
items.title: Quinn Ewers dealing with groin injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tucker Kraft returned to team drills at practice on Sunday.
items.impact: Kraft continues to progress in the right direction. He remains on track to be good to go for the start of the season for the Packers.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) returns to team drills Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders QB Marcus Mariota suffered a sprained MCL that is likely to sideline him for the remainder of the preseason.
items.impact: Mariota suffered the injury in Friday's preseason game against the Dolphins. He'll remain the backup behind Jayden Daniels going into the season.
items.title: Marcus Mariota (MCL sprain) likely out for rest of preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Saints coach Kellen Moore said the hamstring injury Jordyn Tyson is dealing with is still being evaluated.
items.impact: It is not ideal for the rookie as he remains without a clear timetable to return. There should be a further update on Tyson at some point in the next week.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) still being evaluated

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell said the knee injury Jamal Adams suffered in Saturday's preseason game against the Giants is "not good."
items.impact: This was unfortunately expected after Adams was carted off the field on Saturday. There should be another update on his status on Sunday.
items.title: Jamal Adams suffers knee injury that is 'not good'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bills coach Joe Brady said DJ Moore was "good to go" after suffering an ankle injury in Saturday's preseason game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Moore appeared to have his ankle rolled up on after a catch and run. He hauled in 3-of-4 targets for 61 yards in his first official game with the Bills and Josh Allen.
items.title: DJ Moore avoids serious ankle injury Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed QB Brett Rypien.
items.impact: Rypien will compete for a depth role in the Texans quarterback room. Graham Mertz will be placed on IR as the corresponding move.
items.title: Brett Rypien signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Graham Mertz suffered a torn ACL in Thursday's preseason game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Mertz is a former undrafted free agent last season. He will be placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Graham Mertz suffers torn ACL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said WR Michael Pittman Jr. will not practice this week.
items.impact: Pittman has remained sidelined from practice with an undisclosed injury. He'll look to return to practice in the last week of August.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. will not practice this upcoming week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said WR DK Metcalf will not practice this week.
items.impact: Metcalf has remained sidelined from practice with an undisclosed injury. He'll look to return to practice in the last week of August.
items.title: DK Metcalf will not practice this upcoming week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers signed DL Keeanu Benton to a four-year, $72 million contract extension.
items.impact: Benton is coming off recording a career-high 5.5 sacks. He should remain a focal point of the Steelers defensive line.
items.title: Keeanu Benton signs four-year extension with Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals OG Chase Bisontis will undergo surgery to repair a torn MCL in his knee.
items.impact: The surgery could cause Bisontis to miss the entirety of the upcoming season. There should be an updated timetable on the rookie after he undergoes the surgery.
items.title: Chase Bisontis to undergo surgery to repair torn MCL

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Garafolo reports that the Bills, Bears and 49ers are among the teams that have inquired about Bucs DT Vita Vea's availability.
items.impact: Vea continues to seek a trade as the Bucs aren't giving him the new contract he is seeking. This will remain a situation to monitor.
items.title: Vita Vea drawing trade interest from several teams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bryce Young will plan 10-15 snaps on Saturday with the starters.
items.impact: Young will likely play two series as a result. He is looking to take another step forward under center for the Panthers this season.
items.title: Bryce Young expected to see 10-15 snaps in preseason opener Saturday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said RB Jeremiyah Love will be out this week as he deals with a sore ankle.
items.impact: LaFleur said the Cardinals will revisit Love's status after this week. There should be an update on his status by next weekend. Tyler Allgeier will figure to see the first-team reps in the meantime.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love to miss this week with ankle injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks and CB Devon Witherspoon agreed to a four-year, $132 million extension.
items.impact: The extension includes over $101 million guaranteed that now makes Witherspoon the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history. The three-time Pro-Bowl CB will once again lead one of the top defenses in the NFL this season.
items.title: Devon Witherspoon signs historic four-year extension with Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Luther Burden III was able to get in some light work on the field prior to Saturday's preseason game against the Browns.
items.impact: Burden was able to sprint from the 40 to the end zone. He is continuing to slowly work his way back from a groin injury.
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) gets in light work Saturday

title: Fantasy Player News
